  $s=$t.LastIndexOf('<mc:AlternateContent>',$i)
  $e=$t.IndexOf('</mc:AlternateContent>',$i)+'</mc:AlternateContent>'.Length
  $blk=$t.Substring($s,$e-$s)
  foreach($r in $rules){
    $c=([regex]::Matches($blk,[regex]::Escape($r[0]))).Count
    if($c -ne [int]$r[2]){throw "$ph expected $($r[2]) of '$($r[0])' found $c"}
    $blk=$blk.Replace($r[0],$r[1])
  }
  return $t.Remove($s,$e-$s).Insert($s,$blk)
}
